sn22.81:2.2: “Reverend Ānanda, the Buddha has set his lodgings in order himself. Taking his bowl and robe, without informing his supporters or taking leave of the mendicant Saṅgha, he has set out to go wandering alone, with no companion.”
sn22.81:6.4: And what’s the source, origin, birthplace, and inception of that conditioned phenomenon?
sn22.81:6.5: When an unlearned ordinary person is struck by feelings born of contact with ignorance, craving arises.
sn22.81:6.6: That conditioned phenomenon is born from that.
sn22.81:6.7: So that conditioned phenomenon is impermanent, conditioned, and dependently originated.
sn22.81:6.11: and that ignorance are also impermanent, conditioned, and dependently originated.
sn22.81:6.12: That’s how you should know and see in order to end the defilements without delay.
